test_objective: Check that an error is raised if you delete an attribute to temporal entity with an unknown/invalid Entity/Attribute Id

test_cases.name: 015_02_01 Delete an attribute to a temporal representation of an entity with a missing entity id
test_cases.doc: Check that an error is raised if you delete an attribute to temporal entity with an unknown/invalid Entity/Attribute Id
test_cases.template: Delete attribute from temporal entity with unknow entity/attribute id
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/temporal/entities/{entityId}/attrs/{attributeId}?${params_as_string}'
        method set to 'DELETE'
        Delete Attribute From Temporal Entity: and
    Query Parameter: entityId set to '${EMPTY}' and
    Query Parameter: attributeId set to 'speed' and
    Query Parameter: content_type set to 'application/json' and
    Query Parameter: datasetId set to '${EMPTY}' and
    Query Parameter: deleteAll set to 'false' and
    Query Parameter: context set to '${EMPTY}'
}
